1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c5 5.b3.strategy: Gets the king safe and finishes the kingside set-up. White's plan is a long, patient game: the queen's bishop will come to b2 and the pieces aim at the centre from the flanks rather than occupy it.
Defends the c5-pawn, which the knight on c6 does not, and prepares castling. Black's development is complete enough to meet White's flank pressure, at the price of a modest, reactive position.
1.Nf3 d5 2.c4 e6 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 c5 5.b3.name: English Opening: Agincourt Defence, Tarrasch Defence
